inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Start or retrieve an idempotent in-memory visual export.

seconds.description: Display duration for webm/gif; png-sequence refuses a non-null value.

frames.description: png-sequence only: frame count N; frame i is rendered from the stored view state for index i of N (orbit/deformation phase i/N, time/slice phase i/(N-1)); time requires N <= stored acoustic or thermal temperature snapshots; thermal needs the temperature field.

view.description: Optional JSON request context retained for idempotency. The live renderer captures its current scene; this field does not apply a requested view. Use setResultView before exporting.

sideEffects: Starts renderer work and retains an in-memory PNG/WebM/GIF/PNG-sequence (STORE ZIP with manifest.json) artifact; does not download or persist files.
limitations: Argument envelope only; runtime validation remains authoritative.

Single-view GIF supports orbit only: 24 fixed phases i/24, 640x320 letterbox without aspect stretch, opaque RGB332 256 colors, 1–15 second integer centisecond delays summing to duration, 32MiB byte cap and private complete-animation proof bound to exact bytes, field, camera and result revision. It preserves selected physical time and restores viewer controls on completion/cancel; slice GIF is refused. Displacement-only linear static or selected-modal deformation GIF uses separate singleDeformationGifExport: fixed24 phases i/24, cosine scale0-to-peak-to-zero without a duplicated endpoint, peak multiplier0<S<=10000, <=65536 nodes, selected mode0..5 with <=6 modes. This is visualization only, not physical time/load history, modal response amplitude or frequency-driven motion. Private proof binds selected mode, peak multiplier, scale ledger, revision, camera and exact bytes; nonlinear/plastic/stress fields are refused. Stored-time GIF uses the separate singleStoredTimeGifExport capability: temperature or instantaneous pressure only, 2–61 stored frames and at most64MiB nodal scalar history, fixed24 phases i/23 including both endpoints, nearest stored time (ties choose the earlier frame), requested/actual/signed-offset caption and ledger. It does not interpolate or produce newly solved times. Private complete-animation proof binds purpose, revision, camera, schedule and exact bytes. No MediaRecorder or native codec is needed.

Single-view WebM animation time supports acousticTransient/instantPressure only through singleTimeWebmExport capability. It uses VP8 fixed N=min(seconds*24,120), a fixed camera, nearest stored physical frames from first through last with requested/actual/signed-offset ledger, and private encoder proof plus strict WebM/full decoding before publication. Capture fits 1280x640 and bytes stay <=32MiB. Unsupported codecs or incomplete endpoints refuse with no realtime fallback. Preview and other WebM animations retain existing realtime semantics; thermal stored-temperature time uses the separate singleThermalTimeWebmExport capability with the same fixed-frame endpoint checks.
Nonblank requestId; same request identity/content reuses a retained job.

Thermal time WebM requires transient stored temperature frames and the temperature field; heatFlux is final-step only and is refused. Thermal WebM does not interpolate or recalculate fields. Real-time preview remains acoustic-only. Default retention four jobs / 32 MiB; WebM depends on browser support; orbit/deformation/slice remain realtime. Fixed acoustic time frames are saved visualization states, not physical time integration. png-sequence is fixed-frame and wall-clock independent: frames 2-120, at most 4 MiB per frame and 24 MiB per archive (explicit refusals), manifest.json holds per-frame result revision, phase/angle/time/slice position, resolution and SHA-256; cancel discards the archive and restores controls.
